## Overview
The manifest registry stores canonical metadata for packages, schemas, modules,
and tooling. It is the authoritative source of version lineage.

## Manifest Types
- Schema manifests  
- Package manifests  
- Tool manifests  
- Semantic manifests  

## Registry Rules
- All manifests must be canonical  
- All manifests must include version lineage  
- All manifests must be human-readable  
- All manifests must be archived  

## Example Manifest Entry (Simplified)
manifest:
id: "schema.core"
version: "1.0.0"
lineage: ["0.9.0", "0.9.5"]


## Versioning
- manifest-registry-v1  
- manifest-lineage-v1
